items.claim: Shadow-DOM targets can't be highlighted because they get joined into one selector (A+B, `a11y.ts:60`)
Index page never reports or applies document scroll (A+B, `startIndex.tsx:46`)
Index page ignores `vars.set` (B, part of its combined index finding)
Overriding a token leaves vars defined through it stale (A+B, `cssVarsWatch.ts:53`)
A throw from `applyGlobals` on an index page escapes, so the trial never hears back (B, `startIndex.tsx:91`)
Index page's fault drops the stack (B, `startIndex.tsx:68`)
Highlight box misplaced for a target inside an iframe, and doesn't follow its scroll (A+B, `a11yHighlight.ts:42`)
Index page's render fault carried no `seq`, so the shell could not drop a stale one
items.note: The index frame now counts `init`/`config`/`state`/`globals` the way the shell does.
